thread:
anya: hey @design — quick copy check for the model rollback confirmation modal. screenshot in thread. Current copy: 'Rollback to v2.1 — this will permanently revert the served model.' Buttons: [Rollback], [Cancel], link 'View changes'. Thoughts on tone + a11y?

sam: Feels a bit scary. 'Permanently' is strong. Maybe 'Revert to v2.1' or 'Deploy v2.1 to production' is clearer.

maria: Agree with sam. Also we should clarify what happens to traffic and logs. Suggest: 'This will replace the currently served model with v2.1. Requests will use v2.1 after the change. Logs and metrics for v2.2 will remain available.'

lee: For button text, shorter is better — 'Revert' instead of 'Rollback'. For screen readers, aria-label should include the target: e.g. aria-label='Confirm revert to v2.1'.

anya: Nice. Quick UX question — do we need a one-line warning like 'This action cannot be undone'? Feels alarming. Accessibility nit: make sure the modal is an alertdialog so SRs get the full context.

oliver: I'd avoid 'cannot be undone' unless it's truly irreversible. We let users redeploy versions, right? Maybe: 'This will replace the active model. You can redeploy v2.2 later if needed.'

sam: Also useful to show who initiated the rollback and a timestamp in the modal footer for auditability (not main copy, but a small metadata line).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback request queued for v2.1 by anya — /rollbacks create --model v2.1 --requested-by anya

anya: Updated copy proposal: Title: 'Confirm revert to v2.1' Body: 'This will replace the model currently serving production traffic with v2.1. Responses may change after the update. You can redeploy v2.2 later if needed.' Primary button: 'Revert to v2.1' Secondary: 'Cancel' Link: 'View diff' aria-label for primary: 'Confirm revert to v2.1'. Anyone object?

maria: :thumbsup: from me. Small tweak: 'Responses may change' reads clearer than 'Requests will use v2.1'.

lee: Agreed. Also suggest the primary button copy be just 'Revert' in narrow contexts (mobile) — shorter is easier to scan.

anya: Great, I'll update the figma and add an aria-hidden visual-only line for the timestamp + actor in the footer. Thanks!
